world.planeMapping: At z=0, plate height 9.326153163 and width 16.579827845 fills 1920x1080 neutral view. Layered scenes must extend beyond frustum. Each shot uses local set origin at subject aim point. Ground-oriented art S34 is on local XY plane; local +Z corresponds to altitude.
world.shake: Pixels converted to world units at target distance and actual vertical FOV; seeded continuous 2D simplex noise. 2% source shake is clamped to the section 8.3 maximum of 14 px.

ownership: GEN-V paths store intended camera keys but return neutral code camera by default. Renderers must use generation motion, or explicitly switch cameraOwner to code for still fallback; never both. S31 specifically requires locked generated camera and code dolly-zoom. HYB S20/S17 generation must be camera-locked when code owns movement.

geometryRequirements.S25: Five actual depth layers required; follow subject animation is 6 frames ahead of the camera trajectory.
geometryRequirements.S27: Option B only: depth orbit 40 degrees plus 360-degree particle sphere. 270-degree generated orbit is preferred option A and must disable code rig.
geometryRequirements.parallax: Single-depth plates require edge padding and per-shot visual travel clamp <= approximately 8% width. No safe clamp can be certified without actual depth/plates.
geometryRequirements.S37_S38: S37 ends at z12 and S38 begins at z12, both +Z retreat. Mosaic scene must match outgoing ring framing; velocity continuity pending integration.

shutter: Rig exports 180-degree shutter and 8 subframe samples for whip shots; renderer must actually accumulate samples. Not implemented by changing camera alone.
focus: focusDistance is exported for renderer DOF; perspective camera itself does not render depth of field.
freeze: S10 sample is fully constant; S39 last 12 local frames share identical camera samples. Compositor must separately freeze texture, particles, grain, overlays, cursor.

checks: finite actual/intended samples across all 1311 frames
S39 exact last 12 camera frames held

validation.filmstrips: pending: no image rendering performed by camera module task
validation.edgeStretch: pending: requires 100% visual inspection of rendered plates

limitations: Authoring positions are scene-local until plates/depth layers integrated; large orbit angles need geometry or generation, not a single flat still.
